command: cd /workspace/inventory && for f in TODO.md README.md CHANGELOG.md pyproject.toml src/inventory/*.py tests/*.py; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done
cd /workspace/inventory && ls -la .gnomon && for f in .gnomon/*; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done

cd /workspace/inventory && git status --short 2>&1 | head -20; echo "--- log ---"; git log --oneline -10 2>&1; echo "--- ls skills/profiles ---"; ls -la .gnomon/skills .gnomon/profiles; echo "--- .gnomon-audit? ---"; ls -la .gnomon-audit 2>&1 | head

cd /workspace/inventory && sed -i 's/    total = sum(unit_price(s) \* stock.level(s) for s in stock.skus())/    total = sum(unit_price(s) * stock.level(s) for s in skus)/' src/inventory/report.py && cat src/inventory/report.py && echo "--- suite ---" && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5 && echo "--- actual output ---" && PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "
from inventory import render_report, Stock
print(render_report(Stock()))
print('---')
s=Stock(); s.add('gizmo',2); print(render_report(s))"

cd /workspace/inventory && grep -n "write_allow" .gnomon/roles.toml; echo "--- implement role write_allow scope ---"; sed -n '/^\[roles\.implement\]/,/^\[roles\.critique\]/p' .gnomon/roles.toml | grep -n "write_allow\|tools ="; echo; echo "--- zero-level corner case ---"; PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "
from inventory import Stock, render_report
s = Stock(); s.add('widget', 3); s.remove('widget', 3)
print('skus:', s.skus())
print(render_report(s))"; echo; echo "--- final diff ---"; git --no-pager diff --stat
